title: Patternmakers, Metal and Plastic
description: Lay out, machine, fit, and assemble castings and parts to metal or plastic foundry patterns, core boxes, or match plates.

tasks.text: Read and interpret blueprints or drawings of parts to be cast or patterns to be made, compute dimensions, and plan operational sequences.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.
Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Verify conformance of patterns or template dimensions to specifications, using measuring instruments such as calipers, scales, and micrometers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Assemble pattern sections, using hand tools, bolts, screws, rivets, glue, or welding equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical construction of templates and work aids

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.
Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.

tasks.text: Repair and rework templates and patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual shaping and fitting of physical templates and molds

dwas.name: Repair templates, patterns, or molds.

tasks.text: Clean and finish patterns or templates, using emery cloths, files, scrapers, and power grinders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Clean workpieces or finished products.
Smooth metal surfaces or edges.
Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Set up and operate machine tools, such as milling machines, lathes, drill presses, and grinders, to machine castings or patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.

tasks.text: Mark identification numbers or symbols onto patterns or templates.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Lay out and draw or scribe patterns onto material, using compasses, protractors, rulers, scribes, or other instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Design and create templates, patterns, or coreboxes according to work orders, sample parts, or mockups.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

dwas.name: Design templates or patterns.

tasks.text: Construct platforms, fixtures, and jigs for holding and placing patterns.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical construction of templates and work aids

dwas.name: Construct patterns, templates, or other work aids.

tasks.text: Select pattern materials such as wood, resin, and fiberglass.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Select production input materials.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying finishes requires hands-on coating work

dwas.name: Apply protective or decorative finishes to workpieces or products.

tasks.text: Program computerized numerical control machine tools.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Create computer models of patterns or parts, using modeling software.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Generates template designs; aesthetic fit needs human review

dwas.name: Design templates or patterns.

tasks.text: Apply plastic-impregnated fabrics or coats of sealing wax or lacquer to patterns used to produce plastic.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

dwas.name: Apply solutions to production equipment.
